v17.base: v16 chain (lead v6 377Hz glide 20ms formant 1.5, OTT, octave-up, pancake overdub, delay 321ms, EQ2, limiter 0.89, fade-in 4s, tail cut 39.81s)
v17.third_layer: V15 main lead vocal-autotune-v5.wav (pitch x2.73, formant 1.4, D major, glide 55ms) with EXACT V15 EQ1 (HP120, -4@250, +6@3k, +6@5k, +5@8k, +4@12k air, deesser 0.6, comp 0.10/4:1, vol 3.0) then volume 1.5 = +50% louder than V15, mixed through wet chorus+delay as the loudest single layer
v17.complimentary_mix: main v6 lead = body (centre, dry), third v5 layer = brightest + loudest (wet, chorus+delay), octave-up = sparkle, pancake overdub = width, title carved -8@3k — industry layering: lead + louder brighter double + harmony + wide overdub
v17.note: Overall RMS flat vs v16 (0.232 vs 0.233) but vocal-band share +61% and LUFS +0.5dB — third layer cuts through without blowing up overall level; peak still safe under limiter.

v18.base: v17 chain (main v6, third v7, OTT, delay 321ms, EQ2, limiter 0.89, fade-in 4s, tail cut 39.81s)
v18.formant_answer: WORLD spectral-envelope warp: envelope frequency axis resampled by 1/formant_ratio, so formant peaks move up by that ratio while F0 is multiplied separately — pitch and formant are independent knobs. First separated in v11 (pitch 2.0, formant 1.4); v16 pushed formant to 1.5 + breath 0.5.

all_layers_formant_1.5.third_layer: vocal-autotune-v7 NEW (pitch 2.73, formant 1.5, glide 55ms V15-style, breath 0.5, 394Hz, dropouts 2.7%)
all_layers_formant_1.5.harmony: vocal-harm-v6 NEW — v6 lead pitched +5 semitones with rubberband formant=preserved, so formants stay 1.5 instead of shifting with pitch (old: rubberband 1.335 on raw vocal, formants male 1.0, 271Hz -> new 446Hz)
all_layers_formant_1.5.octave_up: vocal-oct-v6 NEW — v6 lead pitched x2.0 with formant=preserved, formants stay 1.5 instead of x2.0 chipmunk (old 406Hz -> new 501Hz)
all_layers_formant_1.5.overdub_low: vocal-overdub-v6 NEW — v6 lead pitched x0.77 with formant=preserved + pancake 0.4Hz, low pitch kept (302Hz) with formants at 1.5 (old: autotune-v2 formant 1.4, 290Hz)

v18.honest_note: Overall meters barely moved vs v17 (RMS/LUFS same) because main+third already dominated the vocal band; the v18 change is timbral — formant character is now consistent across every layer through the whole song, not just the leads.

god_particle_research.method: mix INTO it from the start, hit input targets (green brackets)
god_particle_research.our_build: open-source ffmpeg equivalent of those functions, NOT the paid plugin itself

reverse_engineer_tool: reverse_engineer.py — given any reference song, measures RMS/peak/crest, band power, vocal pitch median, stereo width, and outputs a suggested preset JSON in presets/reverse-<label>.json

neptune_deep_reverse.conclusion: vocal lives F4-G4 (349-392Hz), AVANNA top G4; v14 lead 368Hz sits inside it; outro section is vocal-forward (vocalband 0.229 vs 0.05 elsewhere)

genre_research.genre: hyperpop, specifically digicore — loosely-defined exaggerated pop drawing on electronic, hip hop, dance; NTS digicore guide lists Deko PHANTASY STAR ONLINE ft Yameii alongside Jane Remover, 100 gecs, Glaive, ericdoa, midwxst, SEBii
genre_research.yameii: virtual musician/digital rapper conceived by Osean + Deko, Vocaloid-based (AVANNA), anime/metaverse presentation
genre_research.rulebook_break: AVANNA recommended top is G4 (392Hz) but neptune outro hits 394Hz median and D5 per-second notes — v15 lead median 394Hz deliberately sits at/above that ceiling, matching the reference, not the spec sheet

free_plugins_researched.OTT (Xfer, free): multiband upward/downward compression; lead vocal depth 7-20%, 15% typical, de-esser after — our open-source equivalent wired in v15
free_plugins_researched.Valhalla Supermassive (free): huge evolving delay/reverb, 18 modes — dreamy space; our equivalent is the 321ms tempo delay + chorus + echo taps
free_plugins_researched.Graillon 3 Free / MAutoPitch (free): pitch correction + formant shift — our equivalent is the pyworld autotune/formant scripts
free_plugins_researched.TDR Nova (free): dynamic EQ — our equivalent is the dual-EQ chain (EQ1 vocal, EQ2 bus)
free_plugins_researched.Vital / Surge XT (free, open): synths for future game tracks, not used on this vocal mix
free_plugins_researched.note: VST binaries themselves are NOT redistributed in the public repo (licences); their FUNCTIONS are built open-source in ffmpeg/python and documented in tools/music-production/free-plugins-and-genre-research.md
